translations.web: She was with child. She cried out in pain, laboring to give birth.
translations.bsb: She was pregnant and crying out in the pain and agony of giving birth.
translations.kjv: And she being with child cried, travailing in birth, and pained to be delivered.
translations.asv: and she was with child; and she crieth out, travailing in birth, and in pain to be delivered.
